decks.notes: This aggressive Rakdos deck focuses on fast, efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker, backed up by disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Terminate. The deck aims to apply pressure early on while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Fury and Grief. It also includes some recursion with cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice to keep the heat on the opponent. Overall, the deck is built to be fast, disruptive, and relentless in its pursuit of victory.

The main focus of this UW Control deck is to maintain control over the game through counter spells, removal, and card draw. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building card advantage through cards like Archmage's Charm and Jace, the Mind Sculptor. Using cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Supreme Verdict, the deck aims to control the board and outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion adds an additional threat to the deck while allowing for a flexible sideboard strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty by sacrificing low-cost artifacts like Dwarven Mine tokens or Leyline Binding. The deck also includes counterspells and removal spells to control the board while setting up the combo. Teferi, Time Raveler is included to protect the combo from disruption, and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can be used to tutor for specific combo pieces. Wrenn and Six provide additional value by recurring lands and providing color fixing. The deck aims to win quickly through creative combos and efficient disruption.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays using powerful creatures and disruptive spells to pressure opponents. The deck includes cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Seasoned Pyromancer to quickly establish a board presence. Grief and Thoughtseize are included to disrupt opponent's game plan, while Terminate and Lightning Bolt provide removal options. The deck also includes cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Feign Death to protect your creatures and generate value. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient threats.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful planeswalkers, removal spells, and disruptive creatures to control the game and outvalue opponents. It aims to control the board through a combination of removal and counterspells while using cards like Ragavan and Omnath to generate card advantage. The deck also includes cards like Ephemerate and Endurance to protect its key pieces and outvalue opponents in the mid to late game. The mana base is carefully crafted to ensure consistent access to all necessary colors of mana for the deck's powerful spells.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana using cards like Azusa, Arboreal Grazer, and Primeval Titan to get ahead of the opponent and search for key lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Vesuva. Amulet of Vigor helps untap lands for extra mana, while Dryad of the Ilysian Grove allows for multiple land plays per turn. With the help of Urza's Saga and Summoner's Pact, the deck aims to quickly assemble a powerful board state with multiple Amulets in play to finish off the opponent with massive Valakut triggers.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful equipment combo using cards like Stoneforge Mystic, Puresteel Paladin, and Colossus Hammer. By tutoring for the necessary pieces and equipping them to creatures like Ornithopter and Gingerbrute, the deck can quickly deal a massive amount of damage in a single turn. Additionally, cards like Esper Sentinel and Urza's Saga provide card advantage and utility to help maintain momentum. The key strategy is to efficiently equip creatures with powerful equipment, enabling quick and devastating attacks to overwhelm the opponent.

The main focus of the deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent by playing efficient and aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Murktide Regent, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also includes a variety of disruptive spells like Lightning Bolt, Unholy Heat, and Counterspell to control the board and protect its creatures. The mana base is designed to provide consistent access to the deck's colors and to enable the casting of powerful spells like Brazen Borrower and Archmage's Charm. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent through a combination of speed, aggression, and disruption.

This deck focuses on quickly establishing board presence and dealing damage efficiently by using powerful creatures and burn spells. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds consistency to the deck while the mana base allows for easy access to a wide range of colors. With strong creatures like Scion of Draco and Wild Nacatl, combined with removal options like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck aims to create a powerful combo using cards like Underworld Breach, Grinding Station, and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to repeatedly mill cards from the library and bring them back from the graveyard. It also utilizes cards like Thassa's Oracle and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to win the game once the combo is set up. The deck includes support cards like Mishra's Bauble and Urza's Saga to help dig for combo pieces and accelerate the game. The strategy focuses on quickly assembling the combo and disrupting the opponent to secure victory.

Utilizing Underworld Breach in combination with a variety of low-cost spells and cards like Mishra's Bauble and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to generate value and combo off quickly. The deck aims to leverage its graveyard resources to cast spells from the graveyard multiple times, overwhelming opponents with card advantage and tempo. By efficiently cycling through the deck with cards like Consider and Expressive Iteration, while disrupting opponents with counterspells like Spell Pierce, the deck aims to set up a winning combo turn and secure victory in the late game.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize control elements to stall the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy, while also efficiently ramping up mana and eventually achieving a game-winning combo with Scapeshift and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. This is accomplished through cards like Leyline Binding, Teferi, Time Raveler, and Supreme Verdict to control the board, and cards like Wrenn and Six, Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, and Arboreal Grazer to accelerate mana production. The deck also includes alternative win conditions with Valki, God of Lies and Omnath, Locus of Creation.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Aggro strategy with the Death's Shadow archetype in Modern 1 vs 1 format. By using cards like Death's Shadow, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Dragon's Rage Channeler, the deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total while also controlling the board with cards like Thoughtseize and Lightning Bolt. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an additional layer of flexibility and power to the overall strategy. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Underworld Breach for added recursion and value.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble a powerful equipment combo using Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic to put Colossus Hammer into play. The deck aims to equip creatures like Gingerbrute or Kaldra Compleat with Colossus Hammer to deal massive damage quickly, supported by cards like Shadowspear for trample and lifelink. The deck also includes cards like Esper Sentinel and Urza's Saga for card advantage and ramp, creating a fast and aggressive strategy that can overwhelm opponents in short order.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo where Colossus Hammer is attached to a creature with Puresteel Paladin on the field to create a lethal threat. Stoneforge Mystic and Urza's Saga are used to tutor for the necessary pieces, while other creatures like Esper Sentinel and Giver of Runes help control the board. The deck also includes protection and evasion tools like Shadowspear and Inkmoth Nexus to ensure the combo can go off successfully and deal massive damage to the opponent.

The deck aims to fill its graveyard with creatures using cards like Grief, Street Wraith, and Architects of Will, while controlling the board with counterspells like Force of Negation. Once the graveyard is stocked, the player casts Living End to return all creatures to the battlefield, wiping out the opponent's creatures and gaining a massive board advantage. The deck also includes some flying creatures like Waker of Waves and Colossal Skyturtle to apply pressure in the air, while Brazen Borrower provides additional control and disruption.
